[USER] User is worried about ruining knitwear because of pilling.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for avoiding pilling on knitwear:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Choose high-quality yarns: Investing in high-quality, tightly-spun yarns can help reduce pilling.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Wash knitwear inside out: This helps reduce friction during washing. Use the gentle cycle and mild detergent.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Avoid fabric softeners: They can break down fibers in knitwear. Use specially-formulated wool detergent instead.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Don't hang knitwear to dry: Lay it flat on a clean towel to dry instead.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] To repair existing pills in knitwear:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Use a pill shaver: A handheld tool that cuts off pills gently.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Use scissors: Carefully trim pills off with sharp scissors.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Use a sweater stone: Rubbing it over affected areas can help remove pills gently.  
[USER] User is interested in recommendations for specific brands of yarn or wool detergent.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant cannot recommend specific brands but suggests looking for well-respected brands with good reviews.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider when choosing yarn: fiber content, thickness or weight, and color options.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For wool detergent, look for those formulated for delicate fibers like wool or cashmere and free from harsh chemicals.  
[USER] User plans to ask for recommendations at their local yarn store.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for storing knitwear to prevent damage or dust buildup:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Clean garments before storing: Ensure they are clean and dry to prevent mildew or mold.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Fold garments neatly: Folding helps maintain shape; use padded hangers if hanging.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Store in a cool, dry place: Away from direct sunlight to prevent fiber breakdown.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use mothballs or cedar blocks: To prevent moth damage.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Rotate garments regularly: To avoid dust buildup and indentations.  
[USER] User is excited to try out the storage tips to keep their knitwear in top shape.
